sentences.text:
Mr Ajay Vikram Sin  SI Happy Kumar, 
 Mr Sanjay Verma   Verma, Advs. for  CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 17.05.2023
This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 28/2012 dated 09.02.2012 registered at PS-Ranhola under section 406/498A/34 IPC.
The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 06.10.2016 wherein a sum of Rs. 1 lakh was to be paid.
Rs. 50,000/- has been paid earlier and Rs. 50,000/- has been paid today.
Since there was delay in moving this petition for quashing, the petitioner has offered to pay an additional amount of Rs. 25,000/-to respondent no. 2.
The said additional amount was also been paid and accepted by respondent No. 2.
The petitioner is present in court identified by Mr. Deepak Kumar,
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 11:16:54 Adv.
Respondent no. 2 is also present and identified by Mr. Sanjay Verma, Adv. and SI Happy Kumar, Police Station Ranhola.
The parties state that they have arrived at the settlement out of their own free will, without any threat, pressure, coercion or undue influence.
